spans.s:
The name of a sovereign of Oujein, who is supposed to have flourished about the end of the tenth century; he was a celebrated patron of learned men, and the nine gems, or poets, and philosophers, are often ascribed to his æra.
3 A cowherd.
E.
भुज to enjoy, aff. अच्, and the final consonant unchanged.

m. (-टः)
The country of Bhoja, the present Bhojpur, or the vicinity of Patna and Bhāgalpur.
E.
भोज the same, and कट to go, aff. अच्.

Eating.
E.
भुज to eat, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-षः)
Choice food, a delicacy.
E.
भोजन, and विशेष superior sort.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
Straitened for food.
E.
भोजन, and व्यग्र anxious.

m. (-रः)
Commissariat, stewardship, charge of provender.
E.
भोजन, and अधिकार superintendence.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be enjoyed.
2 To be eaten.
n. (-यं)
Food.
E.
भुज to enjoy, aff. अनीयर्.

ind.
Having fed.
E.
भुज to eat, causal v., क्त्वा aff.

m. (-पः)
A name of KARṆA, the half brother of the Pāṇḍus.
E.
भोज Bhāgalpur, and अधिप sovereign.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
To be eaten, edible.
n. (-ज्यं)
Food.
E.
भुज to eat, ण्यत् aff., and the final unchanged.

m. (-वः)
Chyle, the primary juice of the body.
E.
भोज्य food, and सम्भव production.
